headlines.title: Gambia Central Bank Orders Access, GTBank, FirstBank, Ecobank, Zenith, Others to Phase Out Non-Gambian Staff
Gambia Remittances Hit a Record US$872 Million
Ambassador Liu Jin bids farewell, leaves behind China's remarkable support to Gambia
Gambia's fishers struggle with constant power outages
New study finds heat exposure may increase risk of stillbirth in Gambia

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The Gambia Central Bank ordered Access, GTBank, FirstBank, Ecobank, Zenith, and others to phase out non-Gambian staff. [1]
Gambia remittances hit a record US$872 million. [2]
Ambassador Liu Jin bid farewell, leaving behind China's remarkable support to Gambia. [3]
Gambia's fishers struggle with constant power outages. [4]
A new study finds heat exposure may increase the risk of stillbirth in Gambia. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR GAMBIA
The phase-out of non-Gambian staff at major banks may affect their workforce composition. [1]
Record remittances of US$872 million may boost household incomes and foreign exchange inflows. [2]

KEY RISKS
Constant power outages threaten the livelihoods of Gambia's fishers. [4]
Heat exposure may increase the risk of stillbirth in Gambia. [5]

WATCH ITEMS
The implementation of the Central Bank's order to phase out non-Gambian staff at multiple banks remains unresolved. [1]
